authority.mutation_policy: genesis-only immutable reserved object key; all transaction mutations reject
authority.chain_constraint: application chain_id == authenticated old ValidatorSetV0 chain_id
authority.protocol_constraint: old set and active parameters both use protocol v0

aggregate_bounds.admission_order: count, transaction-byte total, and encoded-receipt-byte total reject before receipt collection, ordered-root encoding, or hashing

execution_binding.cutoff_constraint: cutoff height is checkpoint_height - active snapshot_lead_blocks; JMT version/root/projection are returned as one sealed application-internal value
execution_binding.manifest_constraint: canonical execution bytes bind the exact cutoff manifest entries_root and entry_count next to the state root
execution_binding.projection_constraint: authenticated cutoff projection equals the parent projection; post-cutoff PoCO mutation is rejected

event_output.authority: event attributes and execution_id are never accepted as capability input and cannot reconstruct, mint, or authorize the private checkpoint capability
event_output.consensus_dependency: none; admission and later joins consume only the private capability returned by same-call verification

projection_cache.hit_validation: reread the real root for the requested version before returning the cached authenticated projection
projection_cache.miss_validation: load the projection, then reread and require exact root equality before insertion or return
projection_cache.semantic_invariance: cache hit, miss, eviction, or disabled cache produces the same accept/reject result and capability bytes
projection_cache.remaining_optimization: first-version loading and authenticated key indexing remain H3b2b1 performance work, never authority

production_paths: InitChain authenticates the authority object into AppHash
startup requires local config equality with the authenticated authority object
ABCI snapshot v3/v4 restore requires the same equality before installation
ProcessProposal and FinalizeBlock recompute the capability from actual block inputs and execution results
does_not_establish: handoff, activation, or Core epoch transition
